title: Horse Horoscope 2027: What the Fire Goat Year Means for the Horse
seo_title: Horse Horoscope 2027: Chinese Zodiac Forecast for the Year of the Goat
description: How the Horse is traditionally read in 2027, the Fire Goat year: the Horse's relationship with the Goat, your element by birth year, love and work, the months to watch, and lucky colors and numbers.
lead: After its own year in 2026, the Horse hands over to the Goat on 6 February 2027, and tradition reads the Goat year as friendly for the Horse. Here is how the Horse is read in 2027, what your birth element adds, and the months to watch.
card_text: The Horse in the 2027 Fire Goat year: love, work, your element by birth year and the months to watch.

sections.h2: The Horse and the Goat year
paras: 2026 was the Horse's own year, which tradition treats with some caution. The Goat year that follows is read more kindly: our Goat guide lists the Horse as one of the Goat's supportive matches, so 2027 is counted among the Horse's friendlier years.
A good use of that support is to turn last year's energy into something lasting. The Horse loves new starts; 2027 rewards finishing, settling and building on what is already moving.
after: 2027 is a Ding-wei year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory: Ding is a Fire stem and Wei is the Goat, so it is the year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. These are cultural readings, not forecasts: no evidence shows a year's animal decides anyone's luck. Use them as a prompt to think about your own plans.

after: In the five-element cycles, as Wikipedia sets them out, Wood feeds Fire, Fire produces Earth, Fire melts (or refines) Metal, and Water dampens (or regulates) Fire. These links are a traditional way of describing how each element meets the year, not a prediction.

Born in January or early February? The zodiac year starts at Chinese New Year, so check the start date in the table; if you were born before it, you belong to the sign before the Horse. Our born in January guide and the zodiac checker explain.

sections.h2: Love and relationships for the Horse
paras: The Horse's natural matches in our guide are the Tiger and the Dog, its triangle partners, and the Goat itself. With a supportive partner sign ruling the year, tradition reads 2027 as a good year for commitment, the area the Horse often finds hardest. The Rat, the Horse's opposite, is the pairing tradition marks as the hardest.

sections.h2: Work and money for the Horse
paras: Our guide links the Horse with travel, sales, sports and media, work with movement and variety. In 2027, the advice is to stay with a good project long enough to see it pay off rather than jumping to the next one. With money, the Horse's impatience is the thing to watch; slow, steady saving suits the year.

Each zodiac year is also divided into twelve zodiac months. Each one starts at a solar term rather than at the new moon, beginning with the Tiger month at Spring Commences (Lichun) on 4 February 2027. The dates below are the 2027 solar terms, calculated for Beijing time; they can differ by a day in other time zones.

after: Read with the same rules as the year, the months of your triangle partners, the Tiger (4 Feb – 5 Mar) and the Dog (8 Oct – 6 Nov), are traditionally the smoother ones for the Horse, and the month of your opposite sign, the Rat (7 Dec – 5 Jan 2028), is the one to take extra care in. The Horse month (6 June – 6 July) is your own month.

sections.h2: Lucky colors, numbers and days for the Horse
paras: In our Horse guide, the Horse's lucky colors are yellow, green, purple, its lucky numbers are 2, 3, 7, and its lucky days are Monday and Wednesday. For the full profile, read the Year of the Horse guide; for every sign in 2027, see the 2027 predictions.

faq: Is 2027 a good year for the Horse?
Traditionally yes: our Goat guide lists the Horse as one of the Goat's supportive matches, and 2027 follows the Horse's own year.
What is the Horse's clash month in 2027?
The Rat month, from 7 Dec to 5 Jan 2028. The Rat is the Horse's opposite sign, and tradition marks its month as the one to take extra care in.
What element is my Horse year?

It depends on the year you were born: 1942 is a Water Horse; 1954 is a Wood Horse; 1966 is a Fire Horse; 1978 is an Earth Horse; 1990 is a Metal Horse; 2002 is a Water Horse; 2014 is a Wood Horse; 2026 is a Fire Horse.
What are the Horse's lucky colors and numbers?
In our Horse guide: colors yellow, green, purple; numbers 2, 3, 7; days Monday and Wednesday.
